source: Original K product phase qubits on IID full labels A in Z_q^n; q is a power of two; h=(q/2,0,...,0)
coherent_sampler_access: A read-only full-target-controlled forward program U_t on blank witness/history, with actual amplitudes alpha_(t,y,g). A measured classical output oracle is not this access.
instrument: Compute F(x)+h, apply U once, uncompute the explicit target from unchanged original x, verify F(y)=F(x)+h, then one controlled full-word SWAP and H readout. Fair guesses on invalid outputs pay all failures. Internal sampler history is retained/traced, not silently erased.
clean_sufficient_condition: Phase-aligned clean uniform amplitudes on each nonempty arithmetic fiber implement optimal parity measurement. Native average success is >=1-0.5*sqrt((q^n-1)/2^K). No polynomial sampler is supplied.
proof_obligations: Uniform polynomial forward sampler with coherent read-only target control and explicit amplitude/history law; output coverage alone does not suffice
Compute/uncompute the full target, verify outputs, pay one sampler call, K controlled SWAPs and all preparation/workspace/precision costs
For independent noise use ORIGINAL Hamming distance, not sampled hidden fault labels or a fresh clean phase law
A claimed decoder must survive the single-SWAP spectral norm restriction and its native average second-moment bound
Actual growing-modulus full-target source, not structured dyadic calibration or selected labels

noisy_self_critique.arbitrary_measurement_advantage: sum_(unordered f,f+h) ||C_f||_* / 2^K; generally larger under noise
noisy_self_critique.scope: Any target-only coherent preparation/history and one full-word SWAP with validity/fair failure, on unfiltered original IID labels with independent original Z noise. Not arbitrary original-word control, selected subwords, sequential collective operations or other readouts.

falsifiers: An actual forward/validity/SWAP instrument disagrees with the history-Gram observable
A claimed history-blind transfer equates identical classical output distributions with identical bit signal
A single-SWAP preparation exceeds the sum of leading block singular values
A full native IID source census violates the exact average squared-advantage upper bound
The proposed uniform sampler uses an exponential truth table, free source inverse, uncharged target postselection or unknown preparation environment
